    reason: Available

    message: 'Unready resources: bucket'

  annotations:
    crossplane.io/composition-resource-name: storage-bucket
  generateName: example-render-

    crossplane.io/composite: example-render
  ownerReferences:
  - apiVersion: example.crossplane.io/v1
